title: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares

entities.name: Thalia
aliases: Thalia of the Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: A cathar leader who carries Saint Traft's geist, leads the Order of Saint Traft to Thraben, takes up Avacyn's broken spear, and helps destroy the fused angel Bruna-Gisela.

entities.name: Grete
entities.description: A cathar in Thalia's company with fire in her eyes when possessed by a geist.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A cathar leader who has remained behind, his spirit broken after turning against the Lunarch Council.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: A grim former inquisitor who slays mad angels and brings Avacyn's broken spear to Thalia; he refuses a geist.

entities.name: Saint Traft
entities.description: An ancient demon-battling saint whose geist inhabits Thalia and guides, protects and heals her.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A powerful vampire progenitor of the Voldaren line, in battle armor with a huge hollowed blade, who forms a truce with Thalia and kills Seeta.

entities.name: Seeta
entities.description: A zealous inquisitor who led the hunt for Thalia and heads the so-called Sinpurged, killed by Olivia.

entities.name: Sigarda
aliases: archangel of the Host of Herons
entities.description: The last sane archangel, who confronts her fused sisters, is absorbed, and is freed when Thalia stabs the angel-thing.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: An archangel fused with Gisela into a single monstrous angel.

entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: An archangel fused with Bruna into a single monstrous angel.

entities.name: Bruna-Gisela
entities.description: A huge fused angel of twisted flesh, tentacles, feathered wings and two heads that speaks in a double voice and tries to absorb Sigarda.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The dead archangel whose broken spear Thalia carries.

entities.name: Halmig
entities.description: A scout who rejoined the march changed and was killed by Thalia.

entities.name: Dennias
entities.description: A young cathar trainee from the Elgaud Grounds who is corrupted by magenta tendrils and killed by Thalia.

entities.name: Mathan
entities.description: Dennias's friend who comforts him and screams when the tendrils emerge.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: A skaberen whose skaabs once attacked Thraben.

entities.name: Jerren
entities.description: The bishop Thalia confronted on the Lunarch Council.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The holy city at the mouth of the River Kirch, to which all the monsters and Thalia's army converge.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: The cathedral in Thraben whose plaza hosts the battle with the fused angel.

entities.name: Hanweir
entities.description: A village rumored destroyed, fused people and village into a single entity.

entities.name: Nearheath
entities.description: The region of Gavony where Thalia's order gathered.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: A heathland province of Innistrad containing Thraben.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane at the brink of extinction.

entities.name: Avacyn's Spear
entities.description: Avacyn's broken-tipped spear, too holy for most to touch, which Thalia wields with Traft's power.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: Thalia's army of rebellious soldiers, cathars and clergy sworn to Saint Traft.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church whose remnants carry on despite Avacyn's death and corruption.

entities.name: Lunarch Council
entities.description: The governing body of the church that Thalia confronted and fled.

entities.name: Sinpurged
entities.description: Seeta's deformed inquisitors in heron masks who claim their transformations are sin purged from their bodies.

entities.name: Voldaren Vampires
entities.description: Olivia's vampire army allied with the living against the horrors.

entities.name: Host of Herons
entities.description: The host of angels led by Sigarda.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Soldiers of Avacyn's church in Thalia's army.

events.summary: Thalia recalls being forced to kill her scout Halmig, who rejoined the march changed and squirming.
events.quote: She had been forced to kill him, or whatever he had become

events.summary: Thalia's party meets Rem Karolus, who carries Avacyn's broken spear and confirms she is dead.
events.quote: Even with its tip broken in a jagged line, Avacyn's spear was unmistakable.

events.summary: Thalia's hand is burned by holy light when she tries to touch the spear.
events.quote: A flare of holy light erupted where her hand touched the metal haft

events.summary: With Saint Traft's power, Thalia lifts the spear and mounts it on her saddle as the order's banner.
events.quote: We ride under this banner now,

events.summary: Thalia shows her army the spear and tells them Avacyn is gone, urging them to be their own light.
events.quote: For the memory of Avacyn, of the light and goodness that have fled from the world, we fight!

events.summary: A monster fused from a horse and rider attacks Thalia, numbing her face before her gryff and cathars kill it.
events.quote: But then she strayed too close to a shambling thing the size of a large horse, and it wheeled on her.

events.summary: Dennias is overtaken by magenta tendrils from his body and Thalia kills him mercifully.
events.quote: Her blade took his life quickly

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren parleys with Thalia in midair, offering common cause against the horrors.
events.quote: I'm Olivia Voldaren, lady of Lurenbraum and progenitor of the Voldaren line.

events.summary: Thalia and Olivia agree that vampires and humans will not harm each other until the fight is over.
events.quote: No vampire bite or blade will draw human blood until this fight is through, Heir of Saint Traft.

events.summary: Flashback: Thalia meets the geist of Saint Traft in an ancient chapel and takes him in.
events.quote: Will you take me in?

events.summary: Thalia calls on Saint Traft to summon the spirits of the dead, who possess and shield her soldiers.
events.quote: It was Traft who called them, and they answered his summons.

events.summary: Thalia declines to force possession on those who cannot accept the spirits.
events.quote: I can't make that choice for them.

events.summary: Thalia's army passes through Thraben's Outer Wall and fights alongside vampires through the streets.
events.quote: They were fighting shoulder to shoulder with vampires now, making their way through the streets of the city.

events.summary: Olivia stabs Seeta, chief of the Sinpurged, from behind.
events.quote: Then she saw a jagged blade burst out from Seeta's chest

events.summary: A huge fused angel of flesh, tentacles and feathered wings looms before Thraben Cathedral.
events.quote: Drifting in the air in front of the cathedral was a huge abomination formed of twisted flesh, writhing tentacles...and feathered wings.

events.summary: Thalia attacks the angel-thing on her gryff and is slashed down, her gryff killed.
events.quote: In response, the angel brought its other arm up and slashed a half-dozen finger-claws down her side and across her gryff's flank

events.summary: Sigarda arrives and disowns her fused sisters.
events.quote: You are no longer my sisters,

events.summary: Sigarda slashes her sisters with her scythe but is snatched and being absorbed into the angel-thing.
events.quote: But one of those huge, strangely bifurcated arms snatched Sigarda out of the air.

events.summary: With Saint Traft's help, Thalia lifts Avacyn's spear and is given glowing angelic wings.
events.quote: glowing, translucent wings spread out from her back, the blessing of some unseen angel.

events.summary: Thalia drives Avacyn's spear through the angel-thing's back and into its spine.
events.quote: she drove Avacyn's spear through feathered wings and buried it deep into the spine

events.summary: Sigarda bursts from the dying angel-thing's chest, and the creature falls dead, calling her sister.
events.quote: And it followed Sigarda to the hard stone of the plaza below, curling like a dead spider on the ground.

events.summary: A vast tentacled thing approaches Thraben as a tidal wave of corrupted monsters smashes into the plaza.
events.quote: As it approached, a tidal wave of corrupted monstrosities crested before it, smashing into the plaza and turning the tide once more toward annihilation.

relations.note: She leads a band of rebellious soldiers, cathars and clergy.
relations.quote: she had led a ragtag band of rebellious soldiers, cathars, and clergy

relations.note: She carries his geist within her body as his heir.
relations.quote: communed with the geist who shared her body

relations.note: Truce between humans and vampires for the battle.
relations.quote: No human blade will harm your kind. We agree.

relations.note: She grieves for the broken Odric.
Called leader of the so-called Sinpurged.
relations.quote: Seeta, leader of the so-called Sinpurged
Then she saw a jagged blade burst out from Seeta's chest

relations.note: She was forced to kill the changed scout.
relations.quote: She had been forced to kill him, or whatever he had become

relations.note: She kills him quickly as he is overtaken.
relations.quote: Her blade took his life quickly

relations.note: She spears the fused angel with Traft's aid.
relations.quote: she drove Avacyn's spear through feathered wings and buried it deep into the spine
You are no longer my sisters,

relations.note: Archangel of the Host of Herons.
relations.quote: The archangel of the Host of Herons had never turned against humanity

relations.note: The fused angel contains Bruna and Gisela.
relations.quote: That meant the fused angel-thing contained Bruna and Gisela
